original_findings.consequence: Collector did not verify that all final scores use the same qualified official evaluation pool.
original_findings.evidence: Changing one result test_manifest_sha256 and updating its receipt result hash was accepted.
original_findings.resolution: Root hashes the actual test_manifest.json, checks receipt qualification and lock binding, checks every result against this hash, and records the manifest as an input.
original_findings.title: Final score can bind a different test manifest

original_findings.consequence: A completed-looking audit was not verified to describe the actual analyzed lock and cohort.
original_findings.evidence: An audit with another family_lock_sha256, or with locked_runs absent, was accepted when its receipt audit hash was updated.
original_findings.resolution: Root requires audit.family_lock_sha256 to equal actual lock bytes and audit.locked_runs to equal lock.runs. This representation matches evaluate77.py v4.
original_findings.title: Audit lock and cohort bindings are unchecked

original_findings.evidence: scoring_exit_code false was accepted because Python false equals numeric zero.
original_findings.resolution: Root requires integer scoring and audit exit codes.
original_findings.title: Boolean scoring exit code is accepted as zero
